events.title: We've Passed 200,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Greetings from the Character House dev team! Our very first game, "Character House -Desktop Companion-," has been live in demo form for one month — and we've just officially passed 200,000 wishlists! That's right: with zero marketing spend and no publisher, we hit this milestone in our first month purely through word of mouth from our players.
